RESUME_CONTRACT.carried_state: frozen X state only: head_closed (bool) + open-segment start
RESUME_CONTRACT.no_new_state_representation: no checkpoint serialisation format was invented; the resume replays the open segment, exactly as the frozen semantics imply
guards_in_the_core: is_head length must equal the window length
